summary: Implemented all six ingest functions with validation, immutable cloning, deterministic subscription merging and newest-event routing. Added four boundary tests; original tests unchanged. Integrated own exports and handoff section. Role tests passed 10/10; final full suite passed 36/36 after peer exports completed. Used two indispensable await_next fallbacks for peer shared integration; initial full run had only missing peer exports. Observed diagnostic render cap 192 applies to view, not ingest.
